question: A cylindrical vessel has measured radius $5$ cm and height $12$ cm. If the possible errors in these measurements are $0.02$ cm and $0.03$ cm, respectively, estimate the maximum error in its calculated volume.
explanation:
Volume relation
The volume of the cylinder is
$$V=\pi r^2h$$
Total differential
Considering errors in both $r$ and $h$,
$$dV=2\pi rh\,dr+\pi r^2dh$$
Maximum-error expression
$$|dV|\approx2\pi rh|dr|+\pi r^2|dh|$$
Substitution
$$|dV|=2\pi(5)(12)(0.02)+\pi(5)^2(0.03)$$
$$|dV|=2.4\pi+0.75\pi$$
Simplification
$$|dV|=3.15\pi\text{ cm}^3$$
Conclusion
The estimated maximum error in the calculated volume is $3.15\pi$ cm$^3$.
